reproduction.rationale: Reproduction has two distinct planned information conditions, paper+data and paper+data+author-code, on the same complete original five-target source panel. The only added information must be the pinned author code. Authentic original session/unit/trial/fold/region and target-exposure manifests, final reducer adjudication, independent real/null granular verification, protected analysis execution and cumulative episode budgets are missing; no immutable common protocol or code-delivery identity is fabricated. Source code files and an accepted operator scorer exist, but file presence does not establish paired delivery or AI execution. Both condition outcomes remain unknown.
